SSC Selection Phase 13 Result PDF Out

The Staff Selection Commission has announced the result in the form of PDF. The result comprises a list of all shortlisted candidates for document verification. The exam authority will also release the scorecard of all the candidates in the login window. The SSC Selection Post Phase 13 Result includes essential details of candidates such as name, roll number, category, and rank. Candidates are advised to download the PDF and use the “Ctrl + F” option to search for their roll number or name quickly. It is important to save the SSC Phase 13 Result 2025-26 PDF for future reference.

How to check SSC Phase 13 Result 2026

Candidates can check the SSC Post Phase 13 Result by following the steps provided below.

  • Visit the official website at ssc.gov.in
  • Click on the “Result” tab on the homepage.
  • Select the “Selection Post” option from the list of examinations.
  • Click on the result link to open the SSC Phase 13 Result PDF.
  • Use Ctrl + F to search your Roll Number or Name in the PDF.
  • Download and save the result PDF for future reference.

Details Mentioned in the SSC Phase 13 Result 2025-26

The SSC Selection Post Phase 13 Result 2025-26 PDF contains crucial details. Candidates are advised to check all the details carefully after downloading result. In case of any discrepancy, applicants are advised to contact the exam authority for corrections in the result. Applicants should keep the result PDF safe till the conclusion of the recruitment process. The following details are mentioned in the SSC Phase 13 Result 2025-26:

  • Candidate’s Name
  • Roll Number
  • Father’s Name
  • Mother’s Name
  • Category
  • Rank

What After the SSC Selection Post Result 2026?

Candidates who clear the cut-off will be called for document verification to check their original certificates. For some posts, a skill test may also be held, and after this, the final selection list will be released for appointment.

Updated on: 05 Feb 2026 | 10:30:57 PM IST

How to Calculate the SSC Selection Post Marks?

To estimate your SSC Selection Post Phase 13 score, candidates need to follow the given steps:

  1. Count your correct answers.
  2. Multiply correct answers by 2.
  3. Count your wrong answers.
  4. Multiply wrong answers by 0.50.
  5. Subtract negative marks from positive marks.
  6. Add all subject scores to get the final score.

What After SSC Phase 13 Result 2025-26?

After the declaration of the Phase 13 Result, candidates who qualified in the written examination will be shortlisted for the Document Verification (DV). The Staff Selection Commission will notify the schedule and venue for document verification separately on the official website. Candidates must report for DV as per the instructions mentioned in the official notice. During document verification, candidates will be required to produce original documents such as educational certificates, age proof, category certificates (if applicable), identity proof, and other relevant documents.
